intro: Burundi has about 14 million people and is one of Africa's most densely populated countries.

chapters.title: People
text: Hutu, Tutsi and Twa share the Kirundi language. French and English are also official. Most people are Christian and live by farming on small plots of land.

chapters.title: Cities
text: Bujumbura is the largest city; Gitega is the political capital.
